notes:
REF-BM-03: Title and description are editable before and after save, but collected metadata is not available for pre-save editing.
REF-BM-06: Duplicate URLs are rejected with the existing ID, but the UI does not guide or navigate the user to edit that bookmark.
REF-BM-10: A tag-suggestion API exists, but the tag editor is a plain comma-separated input with no autocomplete.
REF-BM-11: Tag filtering exists in the API, but displayed tags cannot be selected to apply it in the UI.
REF-BM-15: OR, NOT, grouping, and quoted literal operators work, but explicit AND is treated as a search term.
REF-BM-20: Bulk add-tag, archive, and delete exist; remove-tag and read/unread bulk actions are missing.
REF-BM-23: Notes can be written and shown as plain text, but Markdown is not rendered.
REF-BM-24: The local snapshot is a PNG screenshot, not single-file HTML, and PDFs receive no special download handling.
REF-BM-25: No Internet Archive snapshot support is implemented.
REF-BM-29: Saved searches and positive tag filters are stored, but there is no explicit included/excluded-tag bundle model or UI.
REF-BM-30: Netscape HTML import is not implemented.
REF-BM-31: Netscape HTML export is not implemented.
REF-BM-32: Theme and density preferences exist, but default sort, displayed-item count, and font-size settings are missing.
